info.name: Stats API Documentation Analytics Game Pace API

params.name: teamIds
params.description: Comma delimited list of Unique Team identifiers

params.name: leagueIds
params.description: Comma delimited list of Unique league identifiers

params.name: sportId
params.description: Top level organization of a sport

params.name: sportIds
params.description: Comma delimited list of top level organizations of a sport

params.name: gameType
params.description: Type of Game. Available types in /api/v1/gameTypes

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start date for range of data (must be used with end date). Format: MM/DD/YYYY

params.name: endDate
params.description: End date for range of data (must be used with start date). Format: MM/DD/YYYY

params.name: venueIds
params.description: Comma delimited list of Unique venue identifiers

params.name: excludeVenueIds
params.description: Comma delimited list of Unique venue identifiers

params.name: excludeGamePks
params.description: Comma delimited list of unique primary keys

params.name: orgType
params.description: Organization level. Format: T(Team), L(League), S(Sport)

params.name: includeChildren
params.description: Determines weather to include results from an organization's children (ex. a sport would also include results for the teams and leagues)

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma delimited list of specific fields to be returned. Format: topLevelNode, childNode, attribute
